purpose: Test whether independent per-object singleton SAM3 VOS execution exactly reproduces vanilla batched multi-object B0 binary masks.
video_selection: Fixed TRAIN-exposed EXP025 video; not selected from equivalence outcome.
batched_condition: All frame-0 GT objects prompted together.
singleton_condition: Each same frame-0 GT object tracked in its own fresh inference_state.
acceptance_rule: PASS only if every object-frame binary prediction mask is exactly equal between batched B0 and singleton B0.
claim_boundary: Engineering equivalence sanity only. Failure rejects singleton execution as the per-object gating route.
